prompt: Camera at wheel height on the wet grass, a little way down the hill from the bunker in the first image, looking back up at it. The dented grey six-wheeled delivery robot from the second image comes towards the lens, close and sharp, filling the left half of the picture: her amber beacon glowing on its stalk, her torn faded bunting flapping from a wheel, mud on her tyres. Behind her, soft and out of focus up the slope, the bunker's shut green doors, a cream loudspeaker horn dangling mouth-down off its broken bracket above them, a little pale dust still hanging in the air and some fallen rubble at the threshold. Flat grey overcast daylight, the beacon the one warm light. Styled as a 1980s British television drama shot on 16mm film: faded colour, soft contrast, heavy grain. Widescreen, with no writing anywhere.
